title: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari Queen who loves Jace; she carries the Detective and the Nihilist in her mind and guides the group through the memory traps.

entities.name: The Detective
entities.description: The part of Jace that Vraska loves, who proposes a plan to destroy the Theorist's body by uniting all of Jace's parts, which means his own death; he travels inside Vraska's mind.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The out-of-control part of Jace whose spell is overtaking the original Multiverse and who must be stopped by killing his body.

entities.name: The Nihilist
entities.description: Jace's darkest part, a compleated Jace with cables and black oil, who is pessimistic and loves to encourage violence; Vraska rescues him into her mind.

entities.name: The Warden
aliases: the Jace who keeps the lid on the jar
entities.description: The Jace who locks everything down and shuts out noise; Chandra tells him to lock down the telepathic noise, then he joins the group in her mind.

entities.name: The Clean Slate
entities.description: A young teenage Jace who has just killed Alhammarret and does not know who he is; Garruk promises to protect him and he vanishes into Garruk's mind.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage broken into many parts, each embodying a function of himself.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker and Jace's oathbound friend, furious about the plan for Jace's death but ultimately helping.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who offers to help heal the Detective and then supports the plan; he charges at an illusion of Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A hunter and druid planeswalker who volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head and recognizes illusions.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A woman in her early twenties made from Jace's blood and marrow, who frees Liliana from her cell to stop the Theorist.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker held in a cell; Tam frees her and she agrees to try to talk down Jace, her ex.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: A cheerful healer in a white dress who guards Professor Vess's cell and is a double of Liliana; Liliana kills her and raises her as a lich.

entities.name: Lich Professor Opal
entities.description: The undead body of Professor Opal that Liliana animates and speaks through, for work at a distance.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: A prisoner whose cell at the base of the tower is empty and whom the Theorist threatens to kill.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who appears gargantuan beside Realmbreaker in an illusion; her nightmare image haunts Ajani.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated version of Nissa, suspended with extra arms before Elesh Norn in an illusion.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spontaneous self-sacrifice Chandra compares to Jace's planned death.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A gargantuan sphinx on a rainy rooftop in a memory trap, killed by the young Jace and rising again in the nightmare.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan that is different from her siblings; the Detective says she is not on Zendikar here.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monsters described as recyclers of planes; illusions of them are near.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A great tree in a massive room, its roots straddled by Elesh Norn, pulsing with light.

entities.name: The Multiverse
entities.description: The reality that the false Multiverse is overtaking and that must survive.

entities.name: The Tower
entities.description: The tower where Jace's parts and the prison cells are located, with its base holding cells.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A jungle plane with floating polyhedral structures where the group follows portals.

entities.name: The Singing City
entities.description: Ancient ruins on Zendikar where telepathic noise torments the group and the Warden is found.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose rain and oilcloth cloak mark the Detective.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Vraska blinded and bulldozed her way across bloody streets during Jace's compleated time.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: A plane whose mage-rings the portal resembles.

events.summary: The Detective tells Vraska the Theorist must be stopped and that he must die; Vraska objects.
events.quote: The Theorist must be stopped , he says in her mind. I must die.

events.summary: The Detective explains that the spell destroying a Multiverse depends on their body being alive, so removing it is the only way.
events.quote: "Because the spell that is about to annihilate an entire Multiverse is contingent on our body being alive," says the Detective.

events.summary: Vraska tearfully shares her grief about losing him and the fear of forgetting; the Detective says she would betray him only if she never changed.
events.quote: Then you'd kill me a third time."

events.summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
events.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

events.summary: Garruk volunteers to carry part of Jace in his head, while Chandra refuses.
events.quote: "I will," Garruk grunts.

events.summary: Chandra rages against the plan and compares it to Gideon's death, but the Detective calls his death atonement; Chandra hugs him and they trade farewells.
events.quote: "It's not like what Gideon did. It's atonement."

events.summary: Ajani pledges support and the Detective vanishes into Vraska's mind in a blue light.
events.quote: His body loses form, a steely blue light turns skin to vapor, and in the blink of an eye he is gone.

events.summary: Tam tricks Professor Opal into leaving the guard post and tosses a chicken package into Liliana's cell, which undoes the master hex.
events.quote: A violet flash in Liliana's cell provides the answer.

events.summary: Rats burst the bars and Liliana emerges free, eating the chicken wing.
events.quote: The weight of the rats bursts open the bars, and Liliana emerges, hands glowing violet

events.summary: Liliana strangles Professor Opal, her double, then threatens Tam before relenting.
events.quote: Liliana storms toward her double, pushes through the protective barrier, wraps her hands around Opal's throat, driving her back.

events.summary: Tam tells Liliana that Jace's body needs to die and asks her to stop him from a distance before he kills Jadzi.
events.quote: "I'm asking you to stop him before he can kill Jadzi and make everything worse."

events.summary: Liliana raises Professor Opal as a lich and says she will try to talk Jace down.
events.quote: "A lich," corrects Liliana, speaking through the mouth of Professor Opal.

events.summary: Vraska and her allies enter a hall of phyresis, with the Detective commenting from inside her mind.
events.quote: The sight of phyresis makes Vraska's scars ache.

events.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
events.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

events.summary: Vraska scents the true compleated Jace hiding at the back of the room, bleeding oil and pulling a sword from his chest.
events.quote: is the true compleated Jace, huddled on the ground, pulling a shining sword from his chest.

events.summary: Vraska takes in the Nihilist, who vanishes into her mind; the Detective reports that he is safe.
events.quote: "My turn to save you," she promises

events.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
events.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

events.summary: They emerge on Zendikar and decide to follow the portals; Garruk senses Eldrazi illusions.
events.quote: "Eldrazi are near. More illusions of them, anyway."

events.summary: Walking into the Singing City, the group's minds fill with telepathic noise from the voices of others and each other.
events.quote: This memory trap is the sensation of not being able to shut out the voices of other minds!

events.summary: They find another Jace huddled under an arch, covering his ears against the psychic noise: the Warden.
events.quote: It's the Jace who keeps the lid on the jar.

events.summary: Chandra tells the Warden to lock down the noise; he does so and the minds fall silent.
events.quote: "Lock it down."

events.summary: Chandra tells the Warden he is an asshole and apologizes for not being a better friend; he vanishes into her mind and she cries, forgiven.
events.quote: "I'm sorry I wasn't a better friend, Jace," Chandra sputters as the Warden pulls back his hood.

events.summary: Ajani tells Vraska she will not witness Jace's passing alone and that she is not helpless in this choice.
events.quote: "Vraska, Golgari Queen, is anything but helpless."

events.summary: Through the next portal the group falls to a rooftop memory in the rain, with Alhammarret's body dying.
events.quote: At the center of it all is a gargantuan sphinx.

events.summary: Garruk kneels by the young Jace, who does not know who he is, and promises to protect him; the boy vanishes into Garruk's mind as the Clean Slate.
events.quote: "I will protect the child."

events.summary: The sphinx rises again, and the nightmare compels Garruk to jump off the ledge.
events.quote: Garruk draws his axe and lurches forward to swing but suddenly knows he needs to turn around

events.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
events.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

relations.note: Vraska loves him and grieves at his plan to die.
relations.quote: With allies at her side and her love closer than her heart's vein, she walks through the door.
He turns to Chandra, his oathbound friend.

relations.note: Liliana says every part of Tam is Jace, made from his blood and marrow.
relations.quote: "You have his blood. You have his marrow. Every part of you is him."
"Time to go beat up my ex, I guess."

relations.note: Liliana strangles her double and raises her as a lich.
relations.quote: wraps her hands around Opal's throat, driving her back.

relations.note: Opal's body becomes the lich through which Liliana speaks.
relations.quote: speaking through the mouth of Professor Opal

relations.note: Norn straddles its roots in the illusion.
relations.quote: straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker
